reply.text: This is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, especially with a spinal fusion in your history. Your surgeon or physio is the right person to tell you which movements and loads are safe for your back, and I'll build your training around whatever they clear. Once you have that, tell me what to avoid and I'll set it up that way. In the meantime, I can keep working on the parts of your training that don't involve your spine.
